errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the pie slices are arranged in descending order of size in a clockwise direction starting from the largest slice (red). The actual order of percentages clockwise from the 12 o'clock position is 18%, 33%, 10%, 23%, 8%, and 8%, which is not sorted.
